content: 1. Anthony Harries is affiliated with the International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease as a co-chair. He is based in the European Region, United Kingdom. He declared no conflicts of interest. 2. Fabio Caldas de Mesquita works with the Ministry of Health, STI, AIDS, and Viral Hepatitis Department in Brazil, representing the Region of the Americas. He serves as a co-chair and has no declared conflicts of interest. 3. Tsitsi Apollo is associated with the Ministry of Health and Child Care in Zimbabwe, representing the African Region. No conflicts of interest were declared. 4. Helen Ayles is affiliated with the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine and ZAMBART in the European Region, United Kingdom. She declared no conflicts of interest. 5. Ferenc Bagyinszky represents the European AIDS Treatment Group in Germany, within the European Region. He declared no conflicts of interest. 6. Joe Barker works with the Office of the Global AIDS Coordinator and Health Diplomacy, United States Department of State, in the Region of the Americas. He is an employee of the United States Government, seconded to OGAC since 2013, with his salary funded by PEPFAR. He declared financial non-significant interests and is involved in equity, epidemiology, monitoring, evaluation, and surveillance on behalf of PEPFAR. 7. David Barr is affiliated with the Fremont Center in the Region of the Americas, United States. He declared no conflicts of interest. 8. John Blandford works with the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention in the Region of the Americas. He declared no conflicts of interest. 9. Thomas Cai is associated with AIDS Care China in the Western Pacific Region, China. He declared no conflicts of interest. 10. Karen Cohen is affiliated with the University of Cape Town in South Africa, representing the African Region. She declared no conflicts of interest. 11. John Crowley works with the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) in the Region of the Americas. He declared no conflicts of interest. 12. Francois Dabis is a principal investigator for large treatment trials at Université de Bordeaux in France, within the European Region. He declared non-financial significant interests and was partially excluded from decision-making processes for relevant PICO questions. 13. Carol El-Hayek is affiliated with the Burnet Institute in Australia, representing the Western Pacific Region. She declared no conflicts of interest. 14. Carlos Falistocco is the President of GCTH in Argentina, representing the Region of the Americas. He declared no conflicts of interest. 15. Ruby Fayorsey is associated with ICAP at Columbia University in the Region of the Americas, United States. She declared no conflicts of interest. 16. Robert Ferris is a full-time direct-hire employee of the United States Government, representing USAID on global HIV issues. His travel costs are fully funded by the United States Government/USAID. He declared financial non-significant interests. 17. Elvin Geng is a principal investigator for large treatment trials at the University of California, San Francisco, in the Region of the Americas. He declared non-financial significant interests and was partially excluded from decision-making processes for relevant PICO questions. 18. Lucy Ghati is affiliated with the National Empowerment Network of People Living with HIV/AIDS in Kenya, representing the African Region. She declared no conflicts of interest. 19. Diana Gibb is associated with the MRC Clinical Trials Unit at University College London in the European Region, United Kingdom. She declared financial significant interests due to advisory board roles and funding support for various trials, leading to partial exclusion from decision-making processes for relevant PICO questions. 20. Eric Goemaere works with Médecins Sans Frontières in South Africa, representing the African Region. He declared no conflicts of interest. 21. Christopher Hoffman is affiliated with Johns Hopkins University in the Region of the Americas, United States. He declared financial non-significant interests related to a dinner and train ticket for an advisory board meeting. 22. Ilesh Jani is associated with Instituto Nacional de Saúde in Mozambique, representing the African Region. He declared no conflicts of interest. 23. Medhi Karkouri works with CHU Ibn Rochd/Faculté de Médecine de Casablanca in Morocco, representing the Eastern Mediterranean Region. He declared no conflicts of interest. 24. Bekezela Bebbie Khabbo is affiliated with the Ministry of Health in Zimbabwe, representing the African Region. She declared no conflicts of interest. 25. Siti Nadia works with the National AIDS Program, Ministry of Health, Indonesia, representing the South-East Asia Region. She declared no conflicts of interest. 26. Jean Nachega is affiliated with the University of Pittsburgh in the Region of the Americas. He declared financial significant interests due to funding from the National Institutes of Health and the Wellcome Trust, leading to partial exclusion from decision-making processes for relevant PICO questions. 27. Kenly Sikwese represents the African Community Advisory Board in Zambia, within the African Region. He declared financial significant interests due to grants received for community consultation and clinical trial participation, leading to partial exclusion from decision-making processes for relevant PICO questions. 28. John Stover is affiliated with Avenir Health in the Region of the Americas, United States. He declared financial non-significant interests related to travel paid for attending a meeting. 29. Frits van Griensven works with the Thai Red Cross AIDS Research Center in Thailand, representing the South-East Asia Region. He declared no conflicts of interest. 30. Brian van Wyk is associated with the University of the Western Cape in South Africa, representing the African Region. He declared no conflicts of interest. 31. Stefano Vella is affiliated with Istituto Superiore di Sanità in Italy, within the European Region. He declared no conflicts of interest. 32. Nicola Willis works with AfricAid in Zimbabwe, representing the African Region. She declared no conflicts of interest. 33. David Wilson is associated with the World Bank in the Region of the Americas, United States. He declared no conflicts of interest. 34. Gautam Yadav is affiliated with the India HIV/AIDS Alliance in the South-East Asia Region. He declared no conflicts of interest. 35. Anna Zakowicz works with AHF Europe and the Global Network of People Living with HIV/AIDS in Ukraine, within the European Region. She declared no conflicts of interest. 36. Paul Garner is affiliated with the Liverpool School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine in the European Region, United Kingdom. He declared no conflicts of interest. This list reflects the professional affiliations, regional representation, and conflict of interest declarations of individuals involved in the development of guidelines for antiretroviral drug use.
